title: Cat Client
description: A Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 featuring HUD modules (FPS, TPS, armor, zoom), a customizable main menu, a cape system, and QoL features like Fullbright and Toggle Sprint.
body:
Cat Client is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that enhances your gameplay experience with a variety of useful features.
🖥️ HUD Modules
Keep track of important information at a glance with customizable HUD modules, including FPS, TPS, armor display, and a smooth zoom function.
🎨 Customizable Main Menu
Make Minecraft feel like your own with a fully customizable main menu that gives the game a fresh and personal look.
🦺 Cape System
Stand out from the crowd with Cat Client's built-in cape system, allowing you to wear and display your own cape in-game.
⚡ Quality-of-Life Features
Small but impactful improvements to your daily gameplay:

Fullbright – See clearly in dark areas without torches
Toggle Sprint – Sprint without holding the key
